_comment: Question templates and paraphrase pools for eval/build_sets.py. Paraphrases never reuse the words of a subject's name stems, so a paraphrase query can only be answered by meaning, not by word overlap (spec §9.5); the builder still checks the overlap for every generated query. Phase 2 uses the retrieval part; later phases add the agent question templates.

dealer_sales_performance: how many cars each franchise point sells compared with its target
whether outlets hit their volume goals
new_vehicle_sales: factory-fresh units handed over to buyers
first-owner units invoiced to private buyers
used_vehicle_sales: second-hand stock we resell and the profit on it
trade-ins sold on to new buyers
sales_pipeline: negotiations that have not closed yet and when they might
prospects still being worked on by the showroom teams
lead_conversion: how many interested prospects end up buying a car
the share of people who ask about a car and then sign
fleet_sales: bulk purchases by rental firms and company car schemes
cars bought in large batches by companies
pricing_discounts: how far below sticker cars really go
money given away to close each purchase
order_bank: cars customers have bought but not yet received
signed purchases still waiting for the factory or the truck
service_retention: owners who keep bringing their car back to us for maintenance
how many buyers come back for scheduled check-ups
workshop_productivity: how much mechanic time gets billed to customers
billable time versus available bay time in the garages
repair_order_revenue: what customers pay when their car is fixed
labour and parts income from each garage job
warranty_claims: repairs the manufacturer pays for under guarantee
guarantee repair bills submitted by the garages
recall_campaigns: cars called back for a defect fix and how many are done
defect fixes the regulator made us offer and their uptake
first_time_fix: jobs done right on the initial visit
vehicles coming back with the same fault again
customer_satisfaction: how happy people are after buying or getting their car looked after
feedback scores after a garage appointment
service_bookings: reserved garage slots and people who did not turn up
how drivers schedule maintenance online or by phone
parts_fill_rate: how often a component order ships complete straight away
order lines we can serve entirely from what we hold
parts_inventory: components gathering dust on the shelves and what they are worth
ageing spares held in the depots
parts_sales: income from selling spares and accessories to garages
money made on components sold to the trade
backorders: component requests we cannot ship because the item is missing
spares waiting on the supplier before they can go out
supplier_performance: how punctual the companies we buy components from are
late or short shipments from the firms that supply us
vehicle_logistics: how long new cars take to travel from the ship to the showroom
cars arriving late at retail sites
returns: components garages send back to us and why
items dealers hand back and the refunds they get
gross_margin: what is left after paying for the goods we sell
earnings after cost of sales across cars, spares and repairs
pnl: the monthly accounts from turnover down to operating result
the company's earnings and costs for each cost centre
budget_vs_actual: whether each department is over or under what was approved for the year
real figures compared with the approved targets for 2026
opex: what each team pays to keep the lights on
dealer_profitability: which franchise points actually make money after incentives
earnings of each retail partner once support payments are deducted
cash_collections: money customers still owe us and how late they pay
unpaid bills and chasing late payers
revenue_summary: total income across cars, spares and repairs
how much money the whole group brings in
campaign_performance: what our advertising delivers in clicks and enquiries for the money
ad flights and the prospects they generate
web_traffic: how many people browse our site and use the car builder
sessions on the brand site and forms sent from it
brand_nps: how likely buyers are to suggest us to friends
fans versus critics among our customers
marketing_roi: car revenue credited to advertising money
how much each advertising channel earns back
customer_segments: groups of people who purchase from us by age and what they drive
who our purchasers are and what they tend to choose
event_leads: prospects collected face to face at exhibitions and open days
contacts gathered at trade fairs rather than on the web
executive_kpis: the headline company numbers for top management
one page of the most important figures for the directors
dealer_network: new franchise points and sites we shut down
how many retail partners we have and how that is changing
vehicle_stock: cars waiting at retailers and in the compound and how long they have sat there
how many new cars nobody has bought yet
daily_operations: what went wrong yesterday across selling, repairs and transport
the morning list of problems that need attention
data_quality: whether the numbers behind our dashboards can be trusted today
checks on late or broken warehouse loads
customer_360: everything we know about one buyer across purchases, repairs and contacts
a complete picture of each car owner
dealer_benchmark: ranking franchise points against similar-sized ones
how each retail site stacks up against the others
forecast_inputs: the numbers the prediction model uses to estimate future car volumes
historic volumes prepared for predicting next season

region: for each area of the country
model: line by line across the range
mtd: since the start of the month
exec: as a one-page brief for the directors
trend: as a line over the last year
showing how it moved over thirteen months

regional: the one with a page per region
detail: the version with one row per transaction
extended: the edition with history back to 2019
the one with the longer history
area_managers: the cut-down one for area managers
the version limited to my territory
drilldown: the one where I can click into single dealers
